description: Enjoy a seamless modpack installation process and effortless updates with a user-friendly solution that simplifies management, making your gaming experience a breeze.

releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Couple fixes for mod loader quirks, mostly forge. 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v5.0.0-rc.6...v5.0.0-rc.7

## What's Changed

### Security
* The server's TLS certificate is now checked against Mozilla's OneCRL revocation list. Certificates issued by revoked or compromised certificate authorities, such as the recently compromised eMudhra intermediates, are no longer trusted. The list ships with the mod, so the check also works offline, and it refreshes in the background.
* Certificates issued by a public CA are now checked against that CA's revocation list before they're trusted automatically.
* The server's TLS private key is now saved readable only by its owner. Existing keys stay as they are and log a warning.
* The server no longer replaces its TLS key and certificate when one of them is missing. If `cert.crt` exists without `key.pem`, hosting won't start until you restore the key or remove both files.
* Downloads now stop as soon as they run past the size listed in the modpack, so a malicious server or mirror can no longer fill memory or disk.

### In-game updates
* Updates, switches and removals made in-game now always apply right away on best effort basis. Files the game holds open (common on Windows) are finished after the game exits or on the next launch.
* Several changes in one session now stack properly. Each starts where the previous one left off, so the next launch always ends up on the latest one.
* Fixed updates getting stuck on a file that was already deleted.
* A Minecraft or loader version switch is now written to the launcher together with the files of its update, so the launcher never starts versions the installed mods weren't made for.
* If an update's files stay held through two restarts, AutoModpack stops asking and loads what's installed, trying again every launch. From the third launch like that, an in-game message tells you the update is still unfinished.

### Other changes
* Fixed a crash with Sinytra Connector and mixin-booster in the same pack on Forge/NeoForge. Early-service mods that run in place now get each other's names and their own launch options the way ModLauncher gives them, so mixin-booster stands down for Connector like it does in `mods/`. If one of them fails to load, the crash now names it.
* The update helper and the restart window now run in a separate JVM.
* Faster boots and update checks on large packs.
* Quieter console logs.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v5.0.0-rc.5...v5.0.0-rc.6

## Security patch

- The server's TLS certificate is now checked against Mozilla's OneCRL revocation list. Certificates issued by revoked or compromised certificate authorities, such as the recently compromised eMudhra intermediates, are no longer trusted. The list ships with the mod, so the check also works offline, and it refreshes in the background.
- Certificates issued by a public CA are now checked against that CA's revocation list before they're trusted automatically.
- The server's TLS private key is now saved readable only by its owner. Existing keys stay as they are and log a warning.
- The server no longer replaces its TLS key and certificate when one of them is missing. If `cert.crt` exists without `key.pem`, hosting won't start until you restore the key or remove both files.
- Downloads now stop as soon as they run past the size listed in the modpack, so a malicious server or mirror can no longer fill memory or disk.

Clients on 4.0.7 can join servers running 4.0.5, 4.0.6 and 4.0.7.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v4.0.6...v4.0.7

## What's Changed

* Improved `auto-exclude-server-side-mods` behavior, it now excludes only **dedicated** server mods, server mods that may run on client are shipped by default, it will no longer end up excluding mods that potentially clients might need to have in order to connect to the server. To exclude more, use `exclude` list.
* Added `/automodpack generate replace-notes [text...]` to caption the live generation without publishing a new one. Without text it reads `automodpack/host-modpack/patch-notes.md` and clears the file after a successful replace.
* [Windows] Fixed update apply stalling when a managed file stays locked or an empty directory cannot be removed.
* [Windows] Locked files are now recognized by error type, so the update helper behaves the same on non-English locale.
* Fixed resumable downloads losing stream alignment when the server answers with a whole file instead of the requested range.
* Fixed a download that finished without every slice on disk, and a served object whose length does not match what the client expected.
* A mod that cannot be mounted as a zip is treated as unreadable instead of aborting the scan.
* Fixed client storage maintenance counting history objects that were never fetched as missing.
* Filesystems that cannot make a file read-only no longer fail the protection step. AutoModpack probes the filesystem once and skips enforcement there.
* Fixed couple UI bugs like modpack '🎵' button breaking after visiting sub-menu or input screen exiting after button press with some mods.
* A failing command worker no longer crashes the server, and command replies are sent on the server thread.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v5.0.0-rc.4...v5.0.0-rc.5

## What's Changed

* Replaced the pack-wide `auto-exclude-server-side-mods` boolean with a per-group `auto-exclude-server-side-mods` enum, taking `DISABLED` , `METADATA` or `PLATFORMS`. Fresh and existing configs default to `METADATA` (pre rc.3 behavior). Set `PLATFORMS` on a group to also ask Modrinth and CurseForge APIs (rc.3 behavior)
* Config enum values now accept any case
* Interrupted updates resume from files they already wrote, and locked or unreadable live files wait for the update helper after the game exits
* The update helper starts as soon as the game cannot finish the apply, and waits for the game to exit
* Added handle for a new `EarlyBootstrapper` 26.3 neoforge service
* Fixed couple edge cases related to instance timeline restore

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v5.0.0-rc.3...v5.0.0-rc.4

## Hotfix
- Fixed configuration incorrectly swapping all `!/` prefixed file paths to `/!/`

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v4.0.0-beta43...v4.0.0-beta44

# Hot Fix
- Load fabric versions correctly on java 17 #261 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v4.0.0-beta12...v4.0.0-beta13

# Changes
- Fixed `editable` files not being applied on first install #249 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v4.0.0-beta10...v4.0.0-beta11

# Changes
- Support for minecraft 1.20.2/4!
- Modpack now updates as soon as possible making updates *almost* completely seamless!
  - Separate window popups are gone!
- Re-written modpack hosting to [netty](https://github.com/netty/netty).
  - AutoModpack doesn't require new separate port anymore, by default it injects into minecraft network IO (configurable)
  - Downloads should be faster and should be less resource intensive.
- Reduced a lot requests to Modrinth and CurseForge API's.
- Modpack generation should be faster.
- Switched from [Preloading Tricks](https://modrinth.com/mod/preloading-tricks) to our own implementation due to requiring more invasive code.
- Switched from [fabric-networking-api-v1](https://github.com/FabricMC/fabric/tree/1.20.4/fabric-networking-api-v1) to our implementation based of that API but made that it injects before it and we no longer need to worry about other mods kicking us from server before letting download a modpack - previously we were dealing with that by disabling those kicks by key words which wasn't great solution...
- Switched from using [Forgified Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/forgified-fabric-api) in forge version to our own implementations allowing me to port to different forge versions.
- Support for other forge minecraft versions like 1.18.2, 1.19.2 and neoforge 1.20.2, 1.20.4!
- New wildcard, now you can use `!` to exclude some file in `syncedFiles`.
  - Removed `excludeSyncedFiles` from config.
- Mods are now only stored inside automodpack folders.
- Fixed a lot of issues.
- More modular gradle setup.

# Known issues:
- Quilt build is not ready #168
- Auto excluding server side mods doesn't do anything #215
- [Connector](https://modrinth.com/mod/connector) - fabric on forge - mods won't load #214 

## New Contributors
* @wellcoming made their first contribution in https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/pull/199

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Skidamek/AutoModpack/compare/v3.5.2...v4.0.0-beta1
